headline: Sealed the minutes of a non-public session on matters that could affect a person's reputation.
summary: Members met in non-public session under RSA 91-A:3 II (c) to discuss matters that could adversely affect a person's reputation. Members then voted to seal the minutes of that session.
decisions: Approved sealing the minutes of the non-public session; all members voted in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: On motion of Committee Member Stewart, duly seconded by Committee Member Taylor, it was moved to seal the minutes under the provisions of RSA 91-A:3 II (c) for matters, which if discussed in public, would likely affect adversely the reputation of any person. All were in favor and the motion passed.

decision_titles: Sealing the minutes of the non-public session
plain_text:
MANCHESTER SCHOOL DISTRICT SAU #37 
COMMITTEE ON STUDENT CONDUCT 
 
August 17, 2026 4:00 p.m.  
  
1. Chairman Hamer called the meeting to order at 4:11 p.m. 
 
2. The Clerk calls the roll.  
 
 Present: Committee Members Hamer, Want, Stewart, St. John and Taylor. 
 
 
3. A motion is in order to enter into non-public session under the provisions of 
RSA 91-A:3 II (c) for matters, which if discussed in public, would likely affect adversely the reputation 
of any person.  
 
4:11 p.m. 
On motion of Committee Member Stewart, duly seconded by Committee Member Want, it was moved to enter 
into non-public session under the provisions of RSA 91-A:3 II (c) for matters, which if discussed in public, 
would likely affect adversely the reputation of any person.   
 
Roll call: 
Committee Members Hamer, Want, Stewart, St. John and Taylor voted yea. 
 
Present: Dr. Kelly Espinola and Attorney Matt Upton.  
 
 
4. A motion is in order to end the non-public session.  
 
5:21 p.m. 
 
On motion of Committee Member Want, duly seconded by Committee Member St. John, it was moved to 
return to the public session.  All were in favor and the motion passed. 
 
On motion of Committee Member Stewart, duly seconded by Committee Member Taylor, it was moved to seal 
the minutes under the provisions of RSA 91-A:3 II (c) for matters, which if discussed in public, would likely 
affect adversely the reputation of any person.  All were in favor and the motion passed.
March 4, 2026 Student Conduct Agenda 
Page 2 of 2 
 
 
5. If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.  
 
 
On motion of Committee Member Taylor, duly seconded by Committee Member St. John, it was moved to 
adjourn.  All were in favor, meeting adjourned at 5:21 p.m. 
 
 
True Copy.  Attest. 
Respectfully Submitted, 
  
Clerk of Committee
